splitOff.why: It changes the add-details step of the address book in the INS front door, revealing the address, contact and roles fields only once an address is picked or manual entry is chosen. Its claims name app/views/partials/design-release-2.1/consignment-uk-add-address-fields.html, src/server/app/features/address-lookup-spike and tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book/address-book-add-form.spec.ts, so the code is insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/add with its copy, insfrontend:src/server/app/services/address-lookup and tests:tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book, all owned by theme address-book.

It adds a free-text type-ahead with a results list and a screen-reader result count to the address search on the add-details step. That search sits in insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/add with its copy, is served by insfrontend:src/server/app/services/address-lookup and is proved in tests:tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book, all owned by theme address-book.

It changes how the add-details step behaves when the search-only layout is saved empty: the field errors show, the hidden fields are revealed so each error summary link reaches a visible field, and what was typed is kept. That is insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/add with its copy and fields, and tests:tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book, all owned by theme address-book.

It adds an 'Enter address manually' link-styled button below the address search on the add-details step, revealing the address and contact fields. The button, its copy and its proof live in insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/add, insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/copy and tests:tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book, all owned by theme address-book.

It changes what happens when a search result is picked on the add-details step: the search is hidden, the address and contact fields are revealed and the pick is announced to screen readers. That behaviour sits in insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/add, is fed by insfrontend:src/server/app/services/address-lookup and is proved in tests:tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book, all owned by theme address-book.
